span.label: "emotional expression" - AS LICENSED: a facial configuration that reliably and specifically communicates an emotional state. The paper's glossary adds that many so-called emotional expressions are errors of reverse inference
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: "emotional expression" - AS USED IN THE LITERATURE: any facial configuration labelled with an emotion category, applied without checking reliability, specificity, generalizability or validity
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: "accuracy" - AS DEFINED: correspondence to an intended performance that must be perceiver-independent and not subject to the whims of the experimenter
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: "accuracy" - AS IT SHOULD BE RENAMED in this literature: agreement or consensus, because what these studies measure is whether people label a face the same way, not whether the label is correct
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `common view` / `classical view` - THE FRAMEWORK THIS PAPER IS AGAINST HAS TWO NAMES, AND THE SECOND APPEARS EXACTLY ONCE: `a set of beliefs were refer to as THE COMMON VIEW (ALSO CALLED THE CLASSICAL VIEW)`. `content_tags.definitions[1]` already glosses `Common view`; **what was missing is that the literature this paper argues with calls it something else.** A reader searching the corpus for `classical view` - which is what the opposing literature calls itself - would not have reached this record.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Facial movement - an objective, perceiver-independent configuration description that makes no emotional inference

span.label: Facial expression - a perceiver-dependent inference that a facial configuration expresses an internal state
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Perceiver-dependent - interpretation depends on human judgment and may be consistent without being accurate or valid
